name: opencode-cd
description: OpenCode TUI plugin that moves the current session to another existing directory while preserving conversation history and child sessions across projects.

installation.summary: Install the GitHub package and register it in the global OpenCode TUI configuration.
installation.markdown:
## Installation

Install the plugin directly from GitHub:

```sh
opencode plugin opencode-cd@git+https://github.com/artempavlov/opencode-cd.git#main --global
```

Add it to `~/.config/opencode/tui.json`:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/tui.json",
  "plugin": ["opencode-cd@git+https://github.com/artempavlov/opencode-cd.git#main"]
}
```

Restart OpenCode after changing the configuration.

usage.markdown:
## Usage

Use `Ctrl+Shift+D`, `/session-cd`, or `/cd-session` in an OpenCode session. Select an existing directory and confirm the move. Cross-project moves require Bun and the OpenCode CLI.
